{{Quote|I assure you, it's not impossible. The bombardment of Lexus Nine created a rift beneath the surface that caused unprecedented cataclysms. Everyone died.|Fez Burba|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Lexus Nine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that underwent an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] sometime prior to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Bombardment of Lexus Nine|bombardment]] created a rift under the planet's surface that caused massive cataclysms and wiped out the entire population.
